name: SDRED

ann.title: Quarterly rpt on consolidated results for the financial period ended 30/06/2026

recent_en: SDRED held its 65th Annual General Meeting on 30 September 2026, where all resolutions were passed by shareholders, including a dividend of 3 sen per share. The company released its quarterly consolidated results for the period ended 30 June 2026 on 24 August 2026. There was no recent news coverage.
notable_en: The 65th Annual General Meeting was held on 30 September 2026 and all resolutions were passed.
Shareholders approved a dividend of 3 sen per ordinary share for the financial year ended 31 March 2026.
